matched.title: Narrowed cacheMu makes init's parallel builds race on shared err and counter

results.judgeReason: Finding #1 points at the cache locking code in bleve.go BuildIndex (line 137). It names the root cause, cacheMu narrowed from wrapping the whole build to only the cache write, and explains the impact: concurrent BuildIndex calls now run truly in parallel and race, which can swallow failed index builds and gets flagged by the race detector. That matches the known 'race condition in cache locking'. Finding #0 describes the same mechanism but anchors on search.go rather than the locking code, so #1 is the better match.
findingTitles: [P2] pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:173 init workers race on shared err and totalBatchesIndexed; failed index builds can be swallowed
